messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@skywardhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Skyward Health pilot — VPC carveout + pilot pricing

Alex — great to speak yesterday. Attaching an updated SOW and a short summary of what we discussed for the 3-month pilot. TL;DR: customer wants a private VPC deployment in us-west, audit access for up to 90 days after pilot close, and the option to bring their own KMS. They are asking for a 30% pilot discount and an exception for nightly access logs being stored for 6 months (they want 12 months).

Can you confirm if BYOK/KMS is feasible for the pilot (we can support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration but want to confirm with infra)? Also looping Aditya for a quick note on pricing and whether we should route this to Deal Desk for exec clearance on a non-standard audit window.

Attachments: Skyward_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Lauren

lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@skywardhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@skywardhealth.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@skywardhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Skyward Health pilot — VPC carveout + pilot pricing

Thanks Lauren — attaching procurement details on our side. A couple clarifications from security/procurement:
- Audit window: we need evidence of logs and change history for 12 months for our compliance team; will accept a 90-day window if we receive an attestation and SOC2 report.
- KMS: BYOK is preferred; we will need to provide the key material and verify HSM compatibility.
- Network: must be deployable in our us-west-2 VPC with peering and strict egress rules (no outbound to third-party telemetry).

We understand pilot discounts are standard, but procurement expects a written exec approval for any exception to retention/audit defaults. Happy to jump on a call if useful.

Regards,
Alex Morgan
Director, Cloud Integrations — Skyward Health
alex.morgan@skywardhealth.com
Attachments: procurement_instructions.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Skyward Health pilot — request for exec clearance (audit window + 30% discount)

Team — forwarding the thread with Skyward (thread above). Key points for Deal Desk / exec review:
- Customer: Skyward Health (regional med-tech org) — strategic pilot, potential enterprise expansion across multiple regions. Deal ID SWDH-4521.
- Ask: 30% pilot discount on Hosted Dedicated + Private VPC deployment; BYOK/KMS support; accept reduced log retention (90 days) in exchange for SOC2 attestation and a 12-month post-pilot audit window where they can request evidence for compliance.
- Constraints: infra needs to confirm BYOK in a controlled pilot (Aditya, can you confirm HSM/KMS workflow + egress-safe deployment?). Ben — economics: if we grant 30% discount for 3 months what is the revenue impact and approval threshold? Markus — need your sign-off for any precedent we set on audit/retention.

Proposed compromise for approval request to execs: allow a 20% pilot discount (max) with the following guardrails: 1) 90-day standard retention with SOC2 attestation provided up front, 2) documented, limited audit window (90 days active + one scheduled 90-day evidence request within 12 months), 3) BYOK allowed only if KMS entropy/certificate checks are completed and a security checklist is signed. If we get exec sign-off I will send a redlined SOW and updated pricing to procurement.

Attachments: Skyward_SOW_v2.pdf, SOC2-report-2026.pdf

Thanks — need a response by EOD tomorrow to keep procurement timeline.
Lauren

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Skyward Health pilot — request for exec clearance (audit window + 30% discount)

Appreciate the clear summary. I authorize a limited exception for this pilot with the following conditions (non-negotiable):
1) Pilot discount capped at 20% for the 3-month pilot term.
2) Adopt Lauren's proposed guardrails: 90-day retention by default + SOC2 attestation up front and one scheduled evidence delivery within 12 months. Any additional ad-hoc audit requests require Deal Desk pre-approval and a signed change order covering our time.
3) BYOK/KMS is allowed for the pilot but only after Aditya validates the HSM compatibility and the security checklist is signed; no permanent production BYOK until the security certification checklist is completed.
4) Egress controls: deployment must adhere to strict outbound rules; any telemetry endpoints must be pre-approved.

Lauren — proceed to send updated SOW with these guardrails and the 20% discount. Ben — log the precedent in Deal Desk (SWDH-4521) and tag as "pilot-exception". Aditya — confirm BYOK feasibility and list remaining technical blockers.

Markus Klein
VP, Commercial Operations
markus.klein@redwood.ai
